tagline: Brand-blue to violet-blue gradient title bar over soft grey pages, white cards with blue top rules and solid blue cards for emphasis, cyan only as a tiny accent.

palette.description: 60 percent blue, 25 percent violet-blue, 15 percent cyan on pale grey

typography.style: system grotesque stack, bold blue numerals

best_for: Formal but bright corporate decks: company updates, announcements, customer briefings. The gradient title bar gives every content slide the same header.
avoid_for: Creative or moody talks; the palette is deliberately one brand colour family.
name: Gradient Title Band
